name: Furrow Keeper
rules: At the end of your round before Wither, another friendly Harvest creature gains +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Humble furrow keeper tending living soil-lines that visibly thicken a nearby ally, pastoral but uncanny.

name: Briarback
rules: The first time each round Briarback survives creature combat damage, it gains +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Briar-covered beast surviving a hard hit as new thorny mass permanently grows across its back.

name: Hollow Grazer
rules: Before attacking, you may reduce Hollow Grazer's maximum and current HP by 2 permanently, minimum 1. If you do, it gains +3 STR this round.
art_target: Hollow grazer sacrificing chunks of its own woody body before charging with sudden oversized strength.

name: Graftkeeper
rules: On play, move up to 2 permanent STR or maximum-HP bonus points from your other friendly creatures onto Graftkeeper in any combination.
art_target: Graftkeeper receiving living branches and muscle-vines transplanted from two nearby creatures into its own body.

name: Blightmouth
rules: The first time each round Blightmouth gains STR or maximum HP, its next damage dealt this round is increased by 2.
art_target: Blightmouth creature swelling after new growth, mouth opening wider as stored vitality becomes violent damage.

name: The Walking Orchard
rules: At the start of your round, choose up to two other friendly Harvest creatures. Each gains +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: The Walking Orchard: towering mobile orchard-beast with fruiting branches extending life into two smaller Harvest creatures.

name: Prune the Weak
rules: Destroy a friendly creature. Another friendly creature gains STR equal to the destroyed creature's current STR, maximum +3 STR, permanently.
art_target: Pruning scene where one friendly plant-beast is cut down and its strength visibly grafts into another survivor.

name: Forced Bloom
rules: A friendly creature gains +3 STR this round. After it takes a combat action this round, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: Forced bloom exploding across a creature in one violent flowering burst, beautiful and obviously unsustainable.

name: Overgrowth
rules: A friendly creature gains +4 maximum and current HP permanently. It cannot take a combat action this round.
art_target: A creature engulfed in massive protective overgrowth, heavier and healthier but temporarily rooted in place.

name: Thorn Tithe
rules: After a friendly Harvest creature survives combat damage, it gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Thorn Tithe trap erupting after combat, survivor instantly sprouting stronger thorns and thicker living bark.

name: Rootbound Tender
rules: Once per round, when another friendly Harvest creature would take Wither damage, it gains +1 maximum and current HP permanently instead.
art_target: Small rootbound tender intercepting Wither through underground roots, converting decay into healthy permanent growth.

name: Splitbark
rules: The first time each round Splitbark gains permanent STR or maximum HP, another friendly creature gains +1 of the same stat permanently.
art_target: Splitbark creature dividing new growth through branching vascular lines into another nearby ally.

name: Rejuvenation
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When attached ally would take fatal damage, Bloom: leave it at 1 HP instead. For its controller's next 2 turns, restore 2 HP to it at the start and end of the turn.
art_target: Rejuvenation Growth: dormant bud attached to an ally, bursting at fatal injury and wrapping it in restorative shoots.

name: Thornbloom
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When attached ally survives creature combat damage, Bloom for 2 turns. At the start of each of those turns it gains +2 STR that round.
art_target: Thornbloom Growth: thorny flower attachment awakening after combat and feeding short-lived offensive vines into its host.

name: Carrion Root
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When another friendly creature dies, Bloom for 2 turns. At the start and end of each of those turns, attached ally permanently gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Carrion Root Growth feeding from a fallen ally’s remains, then thickening its host at both start and end of the cycle.

name: Nourishing Mycelium
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When attached ally becomes Nourished after being unnourished, Bloom for 2 turns. While Blooming it cannot take Wither damage; restore 1 HP to it at the start and end of each turn.
art_target: Nourishing Mycelium Growth: dense fungal network blooming across a host, shielding it from Wither and slowly restoring it.

name: Predator Vine
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When attached ally destroys an enemy creature in combat, Bloom for 2 turns. The first time each turn it deals damage to another target, it permanently gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Predator Vine Growth: dormant carnivorous vine awakening after a kill, wrapping the host and thickening with each new hit.

name: Ironbark Bloom
signature_detail: Dormant attachment; Bloom on printed trigger
rules: GROWTH — Attach dormant to a friendly Harvest creature. When attached ally takes 3 or more damage from one source and survives, Bloom for 2 turns. At the start and end of each turn, give it Shield 2.
art_target: Ironbark Bloom Growth: dormant bark plates erupting after a heavy surviving hit, forming repeated Shield layers.

name: Cultivate
rules: Choose two different friendly creatures. Each gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Cultivation scene with two different allies simultaneously receiving carefully directed permanent shoots and muscle-vines.

name: Ripen Under Pressure
rules: After a friendly creature survives enemy creature damage, it gains +2 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Ripen Under Pressure trap showing a battered creature suddenly thickening its body after surviving enemy damage.

name: Sapkeeper
rules: The first time each round another friendly creature gains maximum HP, restore 1 HP to it and Sapkeeper gains +1 STR this round.
art_target: Tiny sapkeeper transferring a bead of golden sap into a growing ally while its own posture sharpens.

name: Graft Ox
rules: The first time each round permanent STR or maximum-HP bonuses are moved onto Graft Ox, it gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Massive graft ox receiving transplanted branches and sinew, the graft itself triggering even more permanent growth.

name: Thornfed Stag
rules: The first time each round Thornfed Stag takes damage from one of your own cards or abilities, it gains +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Thornfed stag willingly struck by allied thorns, antlers and body becoming larger from the controlled injury.

name: Orchard Midwife
rules: At the end of your round before Wither, choose a damaged friendly creature that is Nourished. Restore 2 HP to it.
art_target: Orchard midwife tending a damaged nourished creature at dusk, restoring it with fruit-sap and careful living grafts.

name: Feastroot Titan
rules: Once per round, reduce Feastroot Titan's maximum and current HP by 2 permanently, minimum 1. Another friendly creature gains +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Feastroot titan tearing off part of its own huge root-mass to feed permanent power into another ally.

name: Eldergrowth, the First Orchard
rules: CONSUME — Feast While Warm: for the first creature you Consume each round, treat its printed Cost as 2 higher before calculating the Consume bonus, maximum effective Cost 9. REGURGITATE — when another friendly creature dies, the first Regurgitate bonus each round may be split as +1/+1 to two different survivors instead of one.
art_target: Eldergrowth, the First Orchard: colossal ancient orchard entity, cathedral-scale trunk-body, roots and fruit embodying the faction’s entire growth cycle.

name: Selective Breeding
rules: Choose a friendly creature with a permanent STR or maximum-HP bonus. Another friendly creature gains +1 permanent bonus of one stat type that the chosen creature has gained permanently.
art_target: Selective breeding scene comparing two living specimens and transferring one proven permanent trait into another.

name: Cull and Compost
rules: Destroy a damaged friendly creature. Draw 2 cards. Another friendly creature gains +2 maximum and current HP permanently.
art_target: Damaged friendly creature composted into rich glowing soil, two cards emerging while another ally gains thicker roots.

name: Late Harvest
rules: Remove up to 4 permanent STR or maximum-HP bonus points from one friendly creature. Distribute the same number of permanent STR or maximum-HP bonus points among your other friendly creatures in any combination.
art_target: Late-harvest ritual redistributing stored growth from one oversized creature into several different survivors.

name: Deep Roots
rules: When a friendly creature with permanent stat bonuses would be destroyed by damage, remove up to 2 of those bonus points. Prevent 2 damage for each point removed.
art_target: Deep Roots trap ripping permanent growth back into the soil to stop lethal damage at the last instant.
